contract_changes: Versioned migration and renewed dependent deterministic gates required
rules: Each worker uses an isolated Git worktree and branch
No simultaneous ownership of a path
Workers receive bridge interfaces, never ledger keys or writer handles
Controller serializes merges of the exact tested candidate
Schema changes cannot be resolved by inventing a lane-local state model
ownership_semantics: Component maintenance and review responsibility, not an executable scheduling ACL. The board enforces each immutable ticket owned_paths and active prefix locks.
ticket_scope_policy: The operator reviews each immutable seed. A ticket may span maintenance owners (for example T-301 proposals under SYSTEMS, MECHANICS and TESTS); affected owners review the change. This does not bypass active path locks or frozen-contract gates.

path_exemptions.reason: Historical supplied archive; preserve original bytes. Active harness repairs belong in pantheon/.

Shared root documentation or workspace policy: supervisor-maintained; any worker edit needs explicit ticket ownership and serial integration. Controller-protected files retain independent policy review.
